content.text: The write operations live in service functions, which lets the lock run after authorization and before any repository write or event emission. I’m applying it at those service boundaries; background event listeners and notification housekeeping remain outside the guard.
The pure rule and error type are in place. Next I’m wiring summary reporting and the shared write guard, then adding it to the authorized service mutations.

from pathlib import Path
spec={
'issue-service.ts':{'issue:create':'input.orgId','issue:update':'input.orgId','issue:assign':'input.orgId','issue:archive':'orgId'},
'comment-service.ts':{'comment:create':'input.orgId','comment:update':'input.orgId','comment:delete':'input.orgId'},
'project-service.ts':{'project:create':'input.orgId','project:update':'input.orgId','project:archive':'input.orgId'},
'label-service.ts':{'project:update':'input.orgId','project:archive':'orgId'},
'attachment-service.ts':{'issue:update':'issue.orgId'},
'member-service.ts':{'member:update_role':'input.orgId','member:remove':'input.orgId'},
'invitation-service.ts':{'member:invite':'input.orgId'},
'feature-flag-service.ts':{'org:manage_flags':'input.orgId'},
'webhook-service.ts':{'webhook:manage':'input.orgId'},
}
import re
for name,actions in spec.items():
 p=Path('src/server/services')/name; s=p.read_text()
 for action,org in actions.items():
  pattern=re.compile(r'"'^('"\\s*)assertCan\\(["'^'"\\n]*\"'+re.escape(action)+r'\"["'^'"\\n]*\\);"'$'"',re.M)
  ms=list(pattern.finditer(s))
  # For duplicate action strings (issue:update etc) guard each relevant write occurrence.
  offset=0
  for m in ms:
   # Skip permission lines that are reads; action set above excludes these.
   insert=m.end()+offset
   text=f'\\n{m.group(1)}await assertWorkspaceWritable({org});'
   s=s[:insert]+text+s[insert:]; offset+=len(text)
 p.write_text(s)
